page: 6 (statement of financial position); 23-24 (Note 8 - Long Term Debt)
quote: Statement of financial position: 'Long-term debt 15,817,964' (2023: 11,680,150). Note 8: 'Securities-based line of credit; LIBOR plus 2% $ 11,504,098'; 'Line of credit: prime rate plus 6% 4,175,000'; 'Auto loans; fixed rates of 8.90% and 11.71% 138,866'; 'Total long-term debt $ 15,817,964'.
arithmetic: Per brief formula (lines of credit excluded): bonds 0 + notes/loans 138,866 (auto loans) + finance leases 0 = 138,866. Lines of credit reported separately: 11,504,098 + 4,175,000 = 15,679,098. Check: 138,866 + 15,679,098 = 15,817,964 = balance-sheet 'Long-term debt'. Whole dollars as printed.
reporting_entity: Saint Augustine's University (the campus; single entity)
caveats: NEEDS HUMAN DECISION. The audited balance sheet captions the whole $15,817,964 as 'Long-term debt', but $15,679,098 of it is two lines of credit: (1) a securities-based line secured by investments, 'no stated maturity', $11,504,098; the maturity schedule on p.24 places $10,964,188 in 'Thereafter'; (2) a Bank OZK revolving line opened October 2023, $4,175,000, shown as maturing in fiscal 2025. Under the brief's rule lines of credit are excluded, leaving only $138,866 of vehicle loans; if the University's own caption is followed the figure is $15,817,964. There are no bonds, no HBCU Capital Financing loan and no finance-lease liability on the balance sheet. Auditor's report includes a 'Substantial Doubt About the University's Ability to Continue as a Going Concern' paragraph (accreditation removal vote, Notes 3 and 14). Prior-year material weakness that debt receipts/payments were not recorded in the general ledger is reported as 'not resolved in the 2024 audit' (p.51). Subsequent events (p.30): August 16, 2024 credit facility with Gothic Ventures for up to $30,000,000 at 24% interest (after year end, not in the FY2024 balance); unpaid payroll taxes of about $12.5 million with IRS liens. The supplemental ratio schedule (p.34) shows 'pre implementation $13,176,754' and 'post implementation 6,744,213' against 'Total long-term debt net $15,817,964', which do not sum. The FY2022, FY2023 and FY2024 audits were all accepted by FAC in November 2024.
